newsitem.title: DENMARK: ISS see 10 pct better 96 operating profit.
newsitem.headline: ISS see 10 pct better 96 operating profit.

text.p: Danish cleaning group International Service System (ISS) said on Wednesday it expected a 10 percent better group operating profit for whole year 1996 before extraordinary items than in 1995.
The 1995 operating profit was 572 million crowns.
The new forecast was published in a statement announcing a purchase deal with Canada's Aaxis Limited on the sale of ISS United States unit ISS inc.
In August, ISS published first-half 1996 results showing a two billion crown loss caused by falsified accounts at ISS Inc.
